name: helical-groove
why: The recorded reproducer of the helical cut that 'opened past two turns' (8 open mesh edges at 3 turns in the helix commit). The defect was parcad's seam-pcurve pre-pass dropping a pcurve of the cylinder's seam that the other groove-split strips of the same surface still used (BRepCheck_UnorientableShape, B-rep 205.75 mm3 at 3 turns), fixed by the shared-surface guard in a5f1ccda; the boolean itself was right all along. Closed form, derived in the script: the tube inside the cylinder is the screw sweep of the part of its section disk inside r < 3, V = theta * integral ((3 + u) 3 + p^2) / sqrt(9 + p^2) dA = 20.760439 mm3, so the part is 282.743339 - 20.760439 = 261.982900 mm3; the exact B-rep reads 261.9828 through BRepGProp. The recorded volume is the mesh's.
